blurb: Lion World Travel offers luxury safari adventures across Africa, including Tanzania, Kenya, South Africa, and Egypt. Guests experience wildlife viewing in open safari vehicles, stay in handpicked lodges and camps, and enjoy cultural and sustainable tourism experiences. The company provides custom trips, small group adventures, and safari extensions with a focus on comfort, wildlife, and local community impact.
extraNote: Cancellation fees charged by suppliers and beyond operator control · Meet and greet arranged at airport on arrival · Travel insurance mandatory and recommended for coverage including hot-air balloon rides
